t: You're on St George's Road, a one-way road in Southwark running between Westminster Bridge Road and Elephant and Castle, with traffic heading towards the bridge. It was laid out from the 1740s as part of the improvements for Westminster Bridge, linking the bridge to the Elephant and Castle junctions. The name comes from St George's Fields, the open rural area it crossed in the parish of St George the Martyr. Saint George was an early Christian martyr, said to have been a Roman soldier, and since the Crusades he has been venerated especially as a military saint.
